description: This file defines an Express.js route handler for the '/details' endpoint, which retrieves and processes cost data related to language model usage, grouped by user, project, and agent, with support for filtering by date range and user ID. It constructs a complex MongoDB aggregation pipeline to normalize and group data, and resolves missing project names via an external service.

methods.name: parseIsoDate
methods.description: Utility function to parse an ISO date string into a Date object, returning null if invalid.
